# AI Test Workbench (`ai-test-workbench` v4.0.0)

> AI-Agent-First reusable Playwright Test Agents workbench & native multi-protocol MCP Server (`stdio`, Streamable HTTP `/mcp`, Legacy HTTP+SSE `/sse`). Supports Chinese-default docs with paired English `.en.md` docs.

## Core Capabilities
- **Native Multi-Protocol MCP Server (`src/mcp-server.mjs`)**: Supports MCP `2025-11-25`, `2025-06-18`, `2025-03-26`, `2024-11-05` with 12 typed tools (`structuredContent` + `outputSchema` + `ToolAnnotations`), Resources, Resource Templates (`aitest://project/{target}/*`), and bilingual Prompts.
- **Zero-to-One System Explorer (`src/explore.mjs`)**: Read-only crawler with write guards (`DELETE`/`PUT`/`PATCH` & mutating `POST` blocked), multi-portal workspace switcher detection, PII/secret URL redaction, and API waterfall detection.
- **Self-Evolving Living Code Map (`src/codemap.mjs`)**: Fuses host repo routes, broken lazy imports, Spring/Node/Python/PHP controllers, and DB tables with runtime topology, test results, and perf baselines into `knowledge/SYSTEM_MAP.md`.
- **7-Pillar Read-Only MCP Hub (`src/mcp-hub.mjs`)**: Configures and audits Playwright Test Agents, Chrome DevTools, Grafana (`--disable-write`), Prometheus, Loki, Sentry, PostgreSQL/MySQL (read-only), Redis (`--readonly`), k6, and OpenAPI.
- **Perf SLO Engine & Trace-Correlated Diagnostics (`src/perf.mjs`, `src/diagnose.mjs`)**: Chromium CDP Web Vitals (`TTFB`, `FCP`, `LCP`, `CLS`, `DOMNodes`, `JSHeap`) + concurrent GET API `P50/P95/P99/RPS` + Trace-ID RCA playbooks.
- **3-Layer Anti-Fake-Green Gate (`templates/playwright-qa/scripts/audit-results.mjs`)**: `tsc` + `eslint-plugin-playwright`, runtime `results.json` / `waivers.json`, and `--diff-base` Healer diff guard.
